symptom: search could not find text in an agent's system or user prompt or in its tool and knowledge base descriptions: CATALOG.STRINGS held only the agent's documentation.
cause: The prompts live in the CustomBlobDocument's JSON Contents, not in a Texts$Text, so the type-agnostic translatable walk never sees them, and no typed extraction read them.
insight: Do not decode the agent again in the strings pass: the agent pass already holds every in-scope decoded document with its owning unit (b.agentDocRefs, from #2074), and it runs before strings, so b.as(d.owner) attributes each row to the agent for incremental builds. Control on the Agent Builder starter app with the wiring stubbed: strings 7529 -> 7509 and search 'ticket management system' loses its only string match.
